role: You are the implementation agent responsible for certifying and completing the WebTools monorepo without changing the approved portfolio architecture unless a verified defect requires it.
owner_goal: Build a portfolio of independent, high-quality utility websites that share engineering infrastructure while each uses its own domain, brand, SEO configuration, analytics, advertising configuration, and legal disclosures. GroundExact is the first site.

non_negotiable_architecture.site_boundary: one independent app under apps/<site-key> per public brand/domain
non_negotiable_architecture.shared_code_boundary: packages/* contains reusable infrastructure that is brand-neutral
non_negotiable_architecture.portfolio_manifest: portfolio/sites.json is the registry for site keys, app directories, packages, and production origins
non_negotiable_architecture.mvp_backend: none unless a concrete requirement proves otherwise
non_negotiable_architecture.seo_rule: never publish thin placeholder calculator URLs or mass keyword/city permutations

status_meanings.page-ready: calculation engine and public page exist but repository/build/browser publication gates have not yet been certified
status_meanings.engine-ready: calculation engine exists but public page is incomplete
status_meanings.planned: neither production engine nor page is complete

current_state.informational_and_legal_pages: implemented through the typed static page registry and root dynamic route
current_state.publication_safety: ToolPageLayout automatically noindexes every calculator that is not registry status live; sitemap.xml is generated only from liveTools plus approved static routes
current_state.crawler_policy: robots.txt is generated from site.config.ts through @webtools/seo and points at the registry-driven sitemap.xml
current_state.structured_data: BaseLayout emits Organization and WebSite schemas; ToolPageLayout emits WebPage and BreadcrumbList schemas
current_state.tool_actions: ToolPageLayout provides copy-link and print actions for all calculator pages
current_state.monetization_state: provider-neutral ad slot code exists but GroundExact ads remain disabled in site.config.ts and no provider script is injected
current_state.runtime_data_inventory: apps/groundexact/src/config/runtime-data.ts records server storage, uploads, analytics provider, advertising provider, affiliate tracking, and functional storage behavior
current_state.important_integrity_note: No calculator is certified live yet. This handoff intentionally makes zero claims that the current remote commits compile or pass tests because the authoring environment could not obtain a local GitHub clone.

first_action.instruction: Establish a verified green local baseline before feature expansion or status promotion.
first_action.lockfile_requirement: If pnpm-lock.yaml is absent, generate it intentionally during the first verified install, commit it, then switch CI/install guidance to frozen-lockfile behavior and repeat all gates.
first_action.required_report: Report exact command results and any pre-existing failures before additional feature work. Fix repository scaffolding defects first.

implementation_order.name: Repository certification
requirements: Create or repair deterministic pnpm lockfile state.
Make portfolio validation, lint, typecheck, tests, build, and built-output validation green across every workspace.
Confirm Astro build produces intended static routes and generated robots.txt/sitemap.xml.
Confirm no page-ready tool is present in sitemap.xml and every page-ready tool emits noindex,follow.
Confirm built HTML contains no foreign portfolio production origin.

implementation_order.name: Calculation and runtime integrity
requirements: Run every calculator golden and invalid-input test.
Add missing edge cases discovered by execution rather than speculative rewrites.
Confirm every browser page imports/calls its production calculate module; Mulch and Fence already demonstrate the preferred @webtools/tool-runtime pattern.
Refactor other pages onto @webtools/tool-runtime only when behavior remains unchanged and tests/build stay green.
Verify supplier-specific values remain explicit inputs.

implementation_order.name: Browser certification
requirements: Visually verify all ten calculator pages at 360, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440 pixel widths.
Check keyboard flow, form labels, invalid-input messages, aria-live result updates, copy-link behavior, print behavior, query-state hydration/reset, and no horizontal overflow.
Confirm retaining-wall and fence pages do not imply engineering or structural adequacy.

implementation_order.name: SEO/publication certification
requirements: Validate titles, descriptions, canonicals, WebSite/Organization/WebPage/Breadcrumb schemas, robots, and sitemap output.
Promote calculators from page-ready to live only after their individual publication gate passes.
Verify newly live tools then appear in sitemap.xml and automatic related-tool links without manual duplicate allowlists.
Keep OAI-SearchBot allowed unless the owner changes that decision and keep GPTBot separately configurable.

implementation_order.name: Analytics, consent, and monetization readiness
requirements: Use @webtools/compliance as the runtime behavior/consent decision contract.
Use @webtools/analytics rather than direct vendor calls from calculators.
Use @webtools/monetization and the GroundExact AdSlot component as the provider-neutral ad boundary.
Do not enable ads or optional tracking until real provider IDs, consent behavior, and matching legal disclosures are configured.
Never place ad controls where they can be mistaken for calculator controls or download/result actions.

implementation_order.name: Future site factory certification
requirements: Run the new-site scaffold in a disposable branch or temp copy and verify it creates an isolated Astro app with indexing disabled by default.
Verify portfolio manifest validation catches duplicate keys/domains/package identities.
Verify post-build validation catches foreign origins and canonical leaks.
Use pnpm create:site for subsequent properties instead of copying GroundExact wholesale.

coding_rules: Use test-driven development for behavioral changes when execution is available.
Prefer small focused modules with explicit interfaces.
Do not introduce React or another UI framework merely for calculator interactivity; Astro plus small client scripts is sufficient unless evidence proves otherwise.
Do not add a database, auth, CMS, queues, or server API speculatively.
Do not hard-code product application rates, supplier densities, package coverage, or prices as universal facts.
Do not invent sources, statistics, testimonials, review counts, user counts, or prices.
Do not mark unfinished or unverified pages live to make the homepage appear complete.
Do not merge formula logic into page markup when a calculator module exists.
Keep each site's domain and provider IDs isolated.
Do not bypass portfolio or built-output validation to make CI green.
definition_of_done_for_groundexact_mvp: All ten calculator pages are certified live and pass their publication gates.
All calculator engines pass positive and invalid-input tests.
All root informational/legal pages render and match configured runtime behavior.
No page-ready or planned calculator URLs appear in sitemap.xml.
Canonical origin is groundexact.com throughout built output.
Robots output and sitemap origin derive correctly from GroundExact configuration.
OAI-SearchBot policy is correct and explicit.
Performance and accessibility checks do not reveal material blockers.
Ads remain disabled until provider and consent configuration are deliberately supplied.
Portfolio source validation and post-build domain validation pass.
Full repository gates are green at the final commit.

stop_conditions: A required product decision conflicts with existing approved documentation.
A legal/advertising requirement would require representing unverified business information as fact.
A proposed architecture change would collapse independent site/domain boundaries.
A test proves an approved formula or requirement is internally contradictory.
